name: Home and property records
one_line: Property-centred household administration across acquisition, ownership, tenancy, improvement, inspection, taxation and warranty records, using the protected Finance schema while keeping executed leases and other operative instruments on the Legal side of the boundary.

proposed_fields.rule_family: an explicit Subject Property, Property Address, Premises, Parcel, Title Number or equivalent labelled slot on the record itself; filename and free-text mentions remain possible until a resolver binds them to the same property identity
proposed_fields.why_no_existing_key_works: A title register, closing packet, tax bill, inspection, improvement invoice and warranty belong together because they concern the same property, while their issuers change from registry to settlement agent to assessor to contractor. institution therefore identifies the record issuer, not the durable household subject. account_type identifies a kind of financial account, not a home or parcel. location is the place where a capture was taken and cannot safely be widened to the property a document is about. project is a named research or code project, and authored_by is metadata rather than a destination. record_type distinguishes documents but cannot keep two homes apart. One destination-eligible property key is therefore the smallest honest missing join handle.
proposed_fields.note: This is proposed for R1c, not legalised by this template. Until the canonical field catalogue accepts it, property labels remain observations and accepted-group labels; they do not appear in facts_legal or dimension_order. R1c should compare a property-specific key with a broader asset key needed by vehicle and investment situations before minting either.

deterministic: a PROPERTY-TITLE structure: a registry, recorder or land-authority issuer in a weighted title or heading zone, together with a labelled title or parcel identifier, a labelled property description or address, and ownership, tenure, boundary, easement or encumbrance sections. The issuer plus the structured property slots is the signal; the word title alone is not

a PURCHASE-OR-SALE CLOSING structure: a labelled subject-property address beside buyer, seller or borrower transaction blocks, settlement or closing-cost tables, and an execution or completion section. Tables are material here because 00 says 'Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs'. A principal-and-interest servicing structure is instead the finance.loans-mortgage situation

a PROPERTY-TAX or ASSESSMENT structure issued by a public authority: a labelled parcel or property-account slot, a property address, assessed or taxable value rows, a labelled tax period, and an amount-due or payment table. A labelled tax year may support tax_year; a bill date or bare year never does

a HOME-INSPECTION or APPRAISAL structure: a labelled Subject Property or Property Address slot, an inspector or appraiser identity in an issuer block, room-or-system condition sections or valuation-and-comparable tables, and a signed certification or report conclusion. A generic property listing or home-buying article lacks this completed engagement structure

a FILLED IMPROVEMENT-RECORD workbook whose heading identifies the home or improvement programme and whose populated rows carry work description, contractor, invoice date, amount, permit or certificate reference, warranty status and receipt link columns. This relies on 00’s spreadsheet surface: 'sheet names, column headers, visible cell values, table-like regions, formulas only when useful, and dates or identifiers from labeled cells'. A blank renovation budget or inspiration board does not fire

an IMPROVEMENT-COMPLIANCE structure: a building or permit authority in a heading, a labelled application or certificate reference, a property or site slot, a description of completed work, and an approval, inspection or completion result. The property-address-and-work pair distinguishes it from a generic government form

a PROPERTY-WARRANTY packet: a manufacturer, installer or warranty administrator in an issuer zone, a labelled installed-product or system description, a serial or registration identifier, the installation property or job reference, and coverage or claim instructions. The warranty word or serial number alone is insufficient

a TENANCY-ADMINISTRATION record other than the lease itself: a move-in or check-in inventory with a premises address, room, item and condition columns; a deposit or rent receipt with a labelled premises or tenancy reference; or a check-out report comparing recorded condition. An executed lease’s party recitals, covenants and signature block belong to legal.leases-agreements

an archive manifest that co-locates title, closing, survey, inspection, appraisal, tax, improvement, certificate and warranty-shaped member names for one property, inspected without unpacking. 00: 'Archives should be inspected without being unpacked to disk'. The manifest supports a candidate packet; it does not copy member facts onto the archive
needs_llm: whether a contractor invoice or store receipt is evidence of one property improvement rather than an ordinary household purchase. Explicit service-address or job-reference text may settle it; otherwise an accepted improvement packet can support reviewable membership but cannot write a property or business-use fact onto the receipt

an OCR’d deed, title plan, survey, inspection or compliance certificate whose labelled slots are partly lost. The model may interpret the document kind from bounded regions, but it must return unknown when it cannot separate the subject property from an issuer, mailing or neighbouring address

whether a condition report is a tenancy inventory, a sale listing, an insurance-loss schedule or a generic home-inspection checklist. Room names and photographs occur in all four; the role-bearing heading, issuer and completed report structure decide

whether a heterogeneous group is one acquisition, sale, tenancy or improvement packet. The model receives direct anchors, context-supported members and conflicts, and may propose membership only with citations

whether a prose contractor letter, property-manager email or warranty denial is part of a property lifecycle when it lacks a labelled form structure. A person name, address or money figure alone cannot settle the relationship

a multilingual or unfamiliar registry, tax, inspection or permit record whose document-kind labels are not present in the local term catalogue. The model may map the observed structure to record_type, but cannot invent a jurisdiction rule or property field

whether a damage photograph or contractor-portal screenshot joins a repair packet. Capture evidence activates Photos independently; the property association remains a reviewable group membership unless the file’s own OCR carries the necessary property-and-work structure
never_alone: A STREET ADDRESS, PARCEL-LIKE TOKEN OR POSTCODE ALONE. The same address can be the property, the recipient’s mailing address, a contractor’s office, a comparable sale, a utility service address or the location where a photograph was taken. Until the labelled role is clear it remains an observation, and the proposed property field remains unavailable

the words home, house, property, deed, title, closing, inspection, improvement, rent or warranty alone. A home-buying guide, vehicle title, academic case study, product warranty and real-estate listing can carry the vocabulary without being the holder’s property record

an institution, authority, contractor, landlord, agent, manufacturer or insurer name alone. The role-bearing issuer or party position and property-record structure matter; one organization may issue several unrelated kinds of record
a currency figure, valuation, rent, tax amount, invoice total or percentage alone. Money-shaped content appears across every Finance template and in contracts, offers, research and shopping material

a bare year, date or filename period read as tax_year. 00 warns about 'numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values'. Only an explicit tax-year slot on a property-tax or tax-support record can support the field

a source type or extension alone. A PDF is not a deed, a spreadsheet is not an improvement log, a photograph is not a repair record, and a ZIP is not a closing packet. 00 requires the engine to 'treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning'

an existing folder named Home, House Documents, Closing, Renovation or Rental, or a download session containing several official-looking files. 00: 'A session should never be treated as proof of topic'. Existing curated structure can seed review but does not activate Finance or write facts

a mortgage lender or insurer named inside a closing or escrow document. The lender, carrier and tax authority can be counterparties or line items rather than the issuer of the record being examined; frequency does not choose a template

a photographed room, defect, appliance, boundary marker or receipt merely because it sits beside an inspection or improvement file. 00’s firewall is binding: 'The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files'

the absence of EXIF on a property screenshot or photographed document as proof it is a screenshot. 00 says 'the system must not mistake the absence of EXIF for proof that an image is a screenshot'; conflicting capture signals require abstention
an unreadable file named Deed, Title, Closing or Warranty. 00 says unreadable files remain eligible for manual attachment, but the system 'should not infer a purpose from their filename alone'

work_types: property tax bill or assessment notice
grouping_reasons: one property across acquisition, ownership, improvement, tenancy and sale. The anchor is an independently evidenced property identifier plus compatible record structures or a user-confirmed property group, never the address string alone; until property is canonical the identity stays on the group rather than on member facts

one acquisition or sale packet across a closing disclosure, deed or title, survey, inspection, appraisal, tax adjustment, loan instrument and correspondence. It is content-incoherent but purpose-coherent in 00’s sense; every member keeps only its own schema facts

one improvement project across a quote, executed contractor agreement, invoices, receipts, drawings, permit, inspection, completion certificate, warranty and before-or-after photographs. The rich work-scope and property records are anchors; a sparse receipt or photograph can join without inheriting the address, contractor, record_type or tax_year

one tenancy period across the legal lease, move-in inventory, deposit and rent receipts, maintenance correspondence and check-out report. The executed lease remains Legal material, while the accepted group lets the household view remain coherent without converting the lease into a Finance fact

one installed system across its purchase receipt, installation certificate, serial-labelled warranty, maintenance visits and claim correspondence. The shared serial or job reference supports membership; it does not make every file carry the manufacturer or property fact
one document saved twice or revised before execution, represented by duplicate_family and version_family rather than by a property fact

one file may support several accepted groups: a Closing Disclosure can sit in the property-acquisition packet and the mortgage packet; an improvement receipt can sit in the property project and a tax-support packet. Multi-membership remains visible and no group copies facts

template.why: record_type is the only currently legal Finance dimension that remains stable across a property lifecycle. institution is deliberately omitted: one home produces records from a registry, assessor, lender, settlement agent, inspector, contractor, manufacturer, insurer and property manager, so issuer-first would scatter one coherent household subject across unrelated branches. account_type is omitted because ownership, tenancy, improvement and warranty are lifecycle or document roles, not financial account types. tax_year is omitted because most property records carry a transaction, inspection, installation or coverage date rather than an explicit tax year. The intended useful order, if R1c accepts the proposed key, is property then record_type; this row does not smuggle an unratified field into dimension_order. Without that key the honest v1 recommendation is a shallow record_type split over an accepted single-property group, and a multi-property corpus should remain group-led or flat rather than merge homes. This follows 00’s practical rule that 'a parent dimension should provide the context required to understand the child' and its record-domain guidance: 'For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders'. Optional branch patterns keep a purchase, sale, tenancy or improvement packet whole when splitting by record_type would erase its purpose coherence. The user may reverse, remove or flatten the recommendation; 00 says 'The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions.' Safety remains first: this is a placeholder proposal over a protected Finance area, not permission to move or expose a home address.

collides_with.signal: A home purchase produces both situations and a closing packet holds them side by side. A document reporting on serviced debt through principal, interest, escrow, payment and payoff slots is the loan situation; a title, ownership, inspection, improvement, warranty or tenancy-administration structure about the property itself is this situation. The property address is shared evidence and proves neither. This reciprocates the landed loans-mortgage edge.

A homeowners or renters declaration and a property file share the residential address, property description and sometimes an appraisal or loss photograph. Coverage limits, deductible, premium, policy period or claim number identify insurance; title, closing, tax, inspection, improvement or completion structure identifies this situation. The address is the item that must not count for both. This reciprocates the landed insurance-personal edge.

An improvement invoice or installed-system receipt is byte-for-byte a purchase record: issuer, transaction identifier, item rows and total. An explicit service-property slot plus a property-work or installation reference supports this situation; without it the file remains a receipt and may join an improvement group only as a context-supported member. A merchant category, amount or nearby folder never decides. Fixture: Kitchen Remodel - Bright Plumbing - Invoice 7841.pdf.

A property-tax bill and a periodic account record both carry an issuing institution, a period, an account-like identifier, a balance or amount due and a payment table. A parcel or property-account slot beside assessed-value and property-tax rows identifies this situation; a financial-account descriptor beside beginning and ending balances identifies personal records. The issuer name and amount must not count for both.

A home utility bill and a property record share a service address, account reference and amount. A recurring service period, meter or usage table and next-billing structure identifies subscriptions and utilities; title, ownership, inspection, improvement, permit or warranty structure identifies this situation. A service address alone activates neither.

An association assessment and a general property record share the unit address, owner name and money figures. Dues, assessment, meeting, rule or association-account structure identifies the HOA situation; acquisition, title, inspection, improvement and installed-system records identify this one. A unit address or property-manager name alone must count for neither.

Both situations produce titles, inspection certificates, repair invoices and warranties, and the generic document vocabulary is identical. A parcel, premises address, building-system or room structure identifies household property; a vehicle identification, registration, odometer or make-and-model structure identifies the vehicle. The words title, inspection, repair and warranty are the shared evidence items and decide nothing alone.

A tenancy packet mixes an operative lease with rent receipts, inventories and maintenance records. Party recitals, covenants, a term, consideration and an execution block identify the lease as Legal material; a property-record issuer plus receipt, inventory, inspection, tax or improvement structure identifies this household situation. The premises address and rent amount must not count for both. Fixture: Lease Agreement - 18 River Court - Signed.pdf.

falls_through_to.why: Title, closing, property-tax and executed tenancy packets expose exact home addresses, ownership, signatures and financial details. 00 defines this home for 'sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials' and says it 'should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts'.

A one-off inspection, appraisal, completion certificate, warranty or condition report has durable value without necessarily forming a broader accepted group. 00 defines Independent Records for 'standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group'.

An isolated improvement invoice, rent receipt, installation confirmation or warranty registration is transactional without necessarily proving a property association. 00 places 'isolated invoices, delivery confirmations, booking records, boarding passes, purchase receipts, event tickets, and similar transactional documents' here.
A property-shaped workbook or OCR result whose issuer and purpose are only partly understood fits 00’s 'files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision'.

Encrypted deeds, password-protected closing packets and unreadable proprietary property exports fit 00’s 'password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats'. Filename-only rescue remains forbidden.

An ungrouped roof, room, defect or improvement photograph carries Photos facts but no property association. 00 defines this home for 'images with no event, project, reference collection, or photo-family association'.

An ungrouped contractor-portal, property listing or inspection-booking capture may be temporary without being a property record. 00 defines this home for 'screenshots that appear time-sensitive or remind the user of something but have no accepted project, trip, application, or event relationship'.

Home-buying guides, renovation articles and generic property reports are reading material rather than records about the holder’s property. 00 defines Reading Inbox for 'papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association'.

sensitivity_why: This situation concentrates an exact home address or parcel, ownership and tenancy roles, signatures, transaction terms, assessed value, building defects, access-relevant plans, installed-system identifiers and photographs that may carry GPS. 00 requires a local-first posture and says 'Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default'. It also keeps 'Paths, complete extracted text, OCR output, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, user edits, group memberships, and raw sensitive values' local. This row assigns only 00’s potentially-sensitive phrase; it does not author a P7 handling class. Property labels and thumbnails should be redacted in shared UI contexts until the user’s policy permits display.
open_question: Two linked decisions remain. (1) FIELD IDENTITY: should R1c accept a destination-eligible property key, or generalise the need into an asset key shared with finance.vehicle-records and perhaps finance.investment-brokerage? Reusing location would collapse the property a document is about with where a capture was taken; reusing account_type would collapse an asset with an account kind; reusing institution would turn a changing issuer into the household subject. Until this is answered, property identity remains an observation and accepted-group label, and the legal dimension_order remains record_type only. (2) DUAL-SCHEMA SURFACING: deeds, closing instruments, completion certificates and leases can activate Finance and Legal on disjoint evidence because the schema-level also_holds_with edge already exists, while this template deliberately sends executed leases to legal.leases-agreements. When a property packet contains both, should P10 surface one property-centred branch with protected Legal members, or parallel Finance and Legal branches under the shared-material policy? The roster can represent either; choosing a default decides a real household filing shape and is not settled here.
